user.title: Choose detectors
user.description: Follow smoke reports and detector status here. Optional linked sounding, phone alerts and extra actions are set separately in the AlarmMesh panel. New automatic actions are off by default. Self-tests need supported devices and separate confirmation. No smoke reported is not a guarantee of safety.

data_description.source_entity_ids: Choose at least one existing smoke detector in Home Assistant. An unreachable detector can remain selected if Home Assistant still identifies it as a smoke detector.

error.no_sources: Select at least one smoke detector.
error.invalid_sources: Choose detectors from the list. Refresh the page if selection does not work.
error.duplicate_sources: Select each smoke detector only once.
error.unknown_entity: A selected detector no longer exists. Check it in Home Assistant or choose another.
error.wrong_domain: Choose a detector smoke status, not a button or switch.
error.wrong_device_class: Home Assistant does not identify this choice as a smoke detector. Check the detector settings or choose another.
error.own_source: Choose a detector smoke status, not an AlarmMesh overview.
